
Variable -> code 
  U -> N[4]           urchin density (prey)
  S -> N[1]           sea star density (predator)
  O -> N[2] + N[3]    alternative prey (susceptible + non-susceptible)
  i -> pars$rec       fixed urchin recruitment 
  K -> pars$K_U       urchin carrying capacity (barren conditions)
  p -> pars$rho_u     predator preference for urchins
  q -> pars$alpha     predator search/attack rate 
  b -> pars$b_u       urchin saturation coefficient
  c -> pars$c_o       alternative prey saturation coefficient
  e -> pars$e         conversion efficiency of urchin biomass to Pycnopodia population growth
  g -> pars$g         Allee effect threshold parameter
  z -> pars$z         weight of nutritional impact 
  d -> pars$d         Pycnopodia mortality rate
  r -> pars$r         Growth rate for alternative prey
  K_alt -> pars$K_alt Carrying capacity for alternative prey
  exchange -> pars$exchange 

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

diffyq <- function(t, N, pars) {
  S  <- max(N[1], 0)   # Pycnopodia
  U  <- max(N[2], 0)   # Purple urchin
  O  <- max(N[3], 0)   # Alternative prey

  denom <- 1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O

  urchin_consumption <- (pars$rho_u * pars$alpha * max(U - pars$refuge_u, 0) * S) / denom
  alt_consumption    <- (pars$rho_x * pars$alpha * max(O - pars$refuge, 0) * S) / denom

  allee_effect <- S / (S + pars$g)

  birth_S <- pars$e * (urchin_consumption + alt_consumption) * allee_effect
  death_S <- pars$d * S
  dSdt    <- birth_S - death_S

  growth_U    <- pars$rec * U * (1 - U / pars$K_U)
  predation_U <- (pars$rho_u * pars$alpha * max(U - pars$refuge_u, 0) * S) / denom
  dUdt        <- growth_U - predation_U

  growth_O    <- pars$r * O * (1 - O / pars$K_alt)
  predation_O <- (pars$rho_x * pars$alpha * max(O - pars$refuge, 0) * S) / denom
  dOdt        <- growth_O - predation_O

  return(list(c(dSdt, dUdt, dOdt)))
}

pars <- list(
  # Functional response
  alpha  = 1000,
  b_u    = 0.2,
  c_o    = 0.1,

  # Preference weights
  rho_u  = 1.0,    # high preference for urchins
  rho_x  = 0.2,    # low preference for alternative prey

  # Urchin parameters
  rec    = 1,
  K_U    = 16.65,

  # Pycnopodia parameters
  e      = 0.05,
  g      = 0.01,
  d      = 0.08,

  # Alternative prey parameters
  r      = 0.5,
  K_alt  = 30,

  # Refuge parameters
  refuge   = 2,    # alternative prey always inaccessible to predators
  refuge_u = 0.1   # urchins always inaccessible to predators
)

run_mods <- function(P0,
                     g        = 0.01,
                     d        = 0.08,
                     rec      = 1,
                     K_U      = 16.65,
                     Y0       = 0.35,
                     O0       = 30,
                     ode_fun,
                     pars,
                     n_iter   = 500,
                     interval = 1) {

  pars$g   <- g
  pars$d   <- d
  pars$K_U <- K_U
  pars$rec <- rec

  out <- ode(
    y     = c(P0, Y0, O0),
    times = seq(0, (n_iter - 1) * interval, by = interval),
    func  = ode_fun,
    parms = pars
  )

  data.frame(
    time   = out[, 1],
    pycno  = out[, 2],
    urchin = out[, 3],
    alt    = out[, 4],
    P0     = P0,
    g      = g,
    d      = d
  )
}

P0_vals <- 0.06
g_vals  <- c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.03)

results <- expand.grid(P0 = P0_vals, g = g_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(run_mods(
    P0      = .$P0,
    g       = .$g,
    ode_fun = diffyq,
    pars    = pars,
    n_iter  = 500
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    g_label = factor(g, labels = c("No Allee (g=0)",
                                    "Weak (g=0.001)",
                                    "Moderate (g=0.01)",
                                    "Strong (g=0.03)"))
  )

results_long <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = c(pycno, urchin, alt),
               names_to  = "species",
               values_to = "density") %>%
  mutate(species = recode(species,
                          "pycno"  = "Pycnopodia density",
                          "urchin" = "Purple urchin density",
                          "alt"    = "Alternative prey density"))

ggplot(results_long,
       aes(x = time, y = density, colour = species)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Pycnopodia density"       = "orange",
               "Purple urchin density"    = "purple",
               "Alternative prey density" = "steelblue"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ g_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(paste("Density (no. ", m^-2, ")"))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Extract equilibrium values (mean of last 50 time steps)
equilibrium <- results %>%
  group_by(g) %>%
  filter(time >= max(time) - 50) %>%
  summarise(
    pycno_eq  = mean(pycno),
    urchin_eq = mean(urchin),
    alt_eq    = mean(alt),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    g_label = factor(g, labels = c("No Allee (g=0)",
                                    "Weak (g=0.001)",
                                    "Moderate (g=0.01)",
                                    "Strong (g=0.03)"))
  )

print(equilibrium)
```
